FROM ubuntu:22.04
ARG DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
ENV TZ=Etc/UTC
SHELL ["/bin/bash", "-c"]

# Install system dependencies, Python, Node.js, and tools
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    git \
    curl \
    wget \
    gnupg \
    ca-certificates \
    locales \
    locales-all \
    tzdata \
    build-essential \
    libgomp1 \
    chromium-browser \
    fonts-liberation \
    fonts-noto-color-emoji \
    libxss1 \
    python3 \
    python3-venv \
    python3-distutils \
    npm \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Install pip for python3
RUN curl -sS https://bootstrap.pypa.io/get-pip.py | python3 -

# Set environment variables required for chromium and puppeteer
ENV CHROME_BIN=/usr/bin/chromium-browser \
    PUPPETEER_SKIP_CHROMIUM_DOWNLOAD=true \
    puppeteer_config=/app/metagpt/config/puppeteer-config.json

# Set working directory
WORKDIR /app/metagpt

# Clone the repo and checkout specific commit in one layer
ARG COMMIT_SHA=0958cc333ee13d1ce5216ae0bdeaa53b5eacc6ea
RUN git clone https://github.com/FoundationAgents/MetaGPT.git /app/metagpt && \
    cd /app/metagpt && \
    git reset --hard ${COMMIT_SHA} && \
    chmod -R a+rw /app/metagpt

# Create and activate virtual environment, upgrade pip, install dependencies and package
RUN python3 -m venv /opt/venv
ENV PATH="/opt/venv/bin:$PATH"

RUN pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel && \
    pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt && \
    pip install --no-cache-dir pytest pytest-asyncio pytest-cov pytest-mock pytest-html pytest-xdist pytest-timeout && \
    pip install --no-cache-dir -e .

# Install Node global packages
RUN npm install -g @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli

# Default command to keep container alive for post-build testing
CMD ["tail", "-f", "/dev/null"]
